text: I give thanks to God with everything I've got— Wherever good people gather, and in the congregation.
This God of Grace, this God of Love.
He remembered to keep his ancient promise.
Hand them the nations on a platter—a gift!
All his products are guaranteed to last—
All that he makes and does is honest and true:
He ordered his Covenant kept forever. He's so personal and holy, worthy of our respect.
Do that and you'll know the blessing of God. His Hallelujah lasts forever!
